title: Power Rankings: Mavs begin second half on top with champs climbing
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 16
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: We're going to let you in on a little secret: You've got to score at least 92 points to have any chance against Mavs. They're 22-0 when holding teams to 91 or fewer.
